contract:
Contract ManageCashDeskCRUDService::deleteCashDesk(id: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		cashDesk: CashDesk = CashDesk.allInstances()->any(cd: CashDesk|cd.Id = id)
	precondition:
		CashDesk.allInstances()->exists(cd: CashDesk|cd.Id = id)
	postcondition:
		CashDesk.allInstances()->excludes(cashDesk) and
		result = true
}
